meta.name: ai-co-marketing
meta.description: 联合营销策划助手适合内容创作者、市场营销、运营、内容媒体在用户提出“合作营销怎么做”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成转化问题优先级、可复制改稿、实验或跟进行动清单。

copy.tagline: 将合作营销想法拆解为可执行的行动清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需快速将合作营销想法转化为具体执行步骤
copy.tagline_en: Turn co-marketing ideas into actionable checklists
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly turn co-marketing ideas into concrete execution steps

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你拆解合作营销目标，生成转化问题优先级、可复制改稿、实验或跟进行动清单。
howto.when: 当你提出“合作营销怎么做”这类问题，或提供内容目标、受众、参考链接等材料时触发。

say.text: 帮我策划一次联合营销，目标是提升品牌曝光。
say.note: Claude 会生成优先级和行动清单。

say.text: 分析这篇参考文章，给出可复用的改稿建议。
say.note: Claude 会基于链接输出改稿方案。

say.text: 我的受众是中小企业主，帮我列出转化问题优先级。
say.note: Claude 会结合受众生成清单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you break down co-marketing goals and generate conversion question priorities, replicable copy edits, experiments, or follow-up action lists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "how to do co-marketing" or provide content goals, audience, reference links, etc.

say_en.text: Help me plan a co-marketing campaign to increase brand exposure.
say_en.note: Claude will generate priorities and action lists.

say_en.text: Analyze this reference article and give replicable copy suggestions.
say_en.note: Claude will output copy edits based on the link.

say_en.text: My audience is small business owners, list conversion question priorities.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a list tailored to the audience.
